assumptions: A is confirmed before cleanup; B is on the second route and remains behind the shared FINAL gate.
A pending retirement exit is distinct from staleness: pre-witness and post-local-commit exits leave the local replica current.
A stale sender blocks public requests and scheduler steps before dispatch, including cached SUBMIT retries.
A stale recipient blocks its retention query; healthy sender/recipient components may continue.
The harness projects a stale component through one separately restored diagnostic image and checks its authority, original image and anchor remain unchanged at every completed boundary.
The simulator receives public commands, declared cuts, fixed coins and operation-bound approved outputs; no actual image, head, response or staleness result is an input.
exclusions: arbitrary interleavings, more than one pending component fault, or concurrent writes
recovery interrupted mid-install, prepared-envelope faults, or cross-host power failure composition
outgoing SEND to the stale recipient or SEND/CONFIRM through a stale sender in this profile
network timing, packet length, deployment-level availability or liveness guarantees
complete implementation refinement, cryptographic simulation or DP composition
physical storage bounds or performance comparisons
